propositions: rebar must not use git stash push/pop in the tickets worktree because the stash stack is shared across all repository worktrees, allowing a stash created in one worktree to be popped into another
a stash from a source worktree was incorrectly applied to the tickets worktree, leaving the index with unmerged entries and blocking all ticket store writes until manual remediation
the stash-based merge dance in push.py must be replaced with worktree-scoped alternatives such as stash create (commit object, not stack) followed by reset and stash apply by sha, or temporary refs
a stranded index containing paths not tracked on the tickets branch must be auto-healed by classifying them as foreign and discarding them rather than refusing the write
a supported maintenance entrypoint must exist for raw-git operations in the tracker, with backup ref before first write, refusal when unpushed commits exist, and durable audit logging
a break-glass override with explicit written reason must be available for cases the maintenance entrypoint does not cover, loud in output and recorded durably
